basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer from Austin, TX, who loves gaming and coffee. When I'm not debugging code or sipping on my latest espresso concoction, you'll find me exploring the vast universe of Halo or trading items in Genshin Impact. I enjoy discovering new music and sharing song recommendations with friends. A night owl by nature, I usually log on during late evenings after work. Currently single, I value my free time and the flexibility to dive into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in software development, with a bachelor's degree in Computer Science. I picked up gaming as a hobby during college and have been an avid player ever since. My coffee knowledge comes from years of home brewing and experimentation with different techniques and beans.
